task.instruction: In this Python repository, bucket() does not honour a falsey validator: when the validator callable is falsey (e.g. an empty set subclass used as a membership check), bucket() replaces it with the default validator instead of using it. The failing test is tests/test_more.py::BucketTests::test_falsey_validator_is_honoured - it is already applied to the working tree. Find the bucket() implementation in more_itertools/more.py, fix it so a falsey validator is honoured, and verify with run_tests.

fix: honour a falsey validator in bucket (#1308)

fix: honour a falsey validator in bucket (#1308)
`bucket` chose its validator with `validator or (lambda x: True)`, so a
falsey but valid callable (e.g. an empty `set` subclass defining
`__call__`) was silently replaced by the default that accepts every key.
Selecting such a bucket then returned items the validator rejected, and
membership tests wrongly reported them present.
Use an `is None` check instead.

Fix this issue so that the failing tests pass: test_falsey_validator_is_honoured
